standard.title: Coffee and Coffee Products — Vocabulary (कॉफ़ी और कॉफ़ी उत्पाद — शब्दावली) (First Revision)
standard.description: This standard defines the most commonly used terminology, classifications, and process descriptions relating to coffee and coffee products (fruits and seeds of plants of the genus Coffea, as well as processed derivatives intended for human consumption) to establish a unified, standardized national nomenclature and eliminate ambiguity in commercial, regulatory, and scientific contexts.
standard.scope: This standard defines the most commonly used terminology, classifications, and process descriptions relating to coffee and coffee products (fruits and seeds of plants of the genus Coffea, as well as processed derivatives intended for human consumption) to establish a unified, standardized national nomenclature and eliminate ambiguity in commercial, regulatory, and scientific contexts.

amendments.summary: No active amendments have been issued on this reaffirmed copy (NIL on this copy).

certification.description: Voluntary/Identical Adoption. Since IS 7236 : 2013 is a terminology and vocabulary standard rather than a physical consumer product, it does not carry an individual mandatory BIS 'ISI Mark' product stamp. However, its terminology represents the exact legally binding dictionary utilized by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), the Central Excise Department, and the Ministry of Commerce and Industry during agricultural grading, trademark disputes, customs classifications, and food safety compliance evaluations.
requirements: General term for the fruits and seeds of plants of the genus Coffea, generally the cultivated species, as well as products from these fruits and seeds in different stages of processing and use, intended for human consumption.
Defines this as the fresh or dried fruit of the coffee plant, containing one or two seeds (beans) wrapped in their endocarps (parchments) and pulp.
Defines this as the dried cherry coffee (fruit of the coffee plant) after drying, before any mechanical removal of the outer layers.
Defines this as coffee beans wrapped in their protective endocarp (parchment) layer.
Defines this as coffee beans that are not roasted and have been separated from their outer layers.
Defines this as green coffee that has been exposed to a humid atmosphere (monsoon winds) to absorb moisture and swell, altering its physical color and taste characteristics.
Defines this as green coffee beans from which the silverskin has been completely or partially removed by mechanical polishing.
Defines this as coffee from which caffeine has been extracted, restricting residual caffeine content in accordance with product specifications.
Defines this as coffee obtained by roasting green coffee to develop its aroma, flavor, and characteristic brown color.
Defines this as the dry water-soluble product obtained by the extraction of roasted coffee using only water as the solvent, and dried.
Defines this as the liquid beverage obtained by extracting roasted and ground coffee with hot water.

In reporting results of any tests or analyses made in accordance with standards using this vocabulary, if the final value is to be rounded off, it shall be done in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained should match the specified value.
